newsitem.title: USA: Mellon launches Illinois-based trust unit.
newsitem.headline: Mellon launches Illinois-based trust unit.

text.p: Mellon Bank Corp said Tuesday it formed a trust company subsidiary that will be based in Chicago and will provide global custody, accounting and regulatory reporting services to Illinois insurance companies.
The new unit will be known as Mellon Trust Co of Illinois.

Mellon said since the charter was approved last month three Illinois insurers have chosen Mellon Trust to provide custody services for accounts with $37 billion in assets. The insurers were not identified. Illinois-based insurers are required by law to hire in-state custody banks.
